title: 逾期在途与缺货叠加
context: 库存＋采购联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 截止2025年底，将已到期未足量收货采购行按仓库商品汇总；结合当前库存和近30日销量，筛选库存低于30日需求且逾期未收货量>0的商品。
commonError: 将拒收库存算作可售库存会低估缺口。
mysqlSql: WITH p AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(quantity_ordered-accepted) overdue FROM v_po_lines WHERE promised_date<='2025-12-31' AND accepted<quantity_ordered GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id) SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,s.sold demand,p.overdue overdue_units,s.sold-i.quantity shortage FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN p ON p.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND p.product_id=i.product_id JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND i.quantity<s.sold ORDER BY shortage DESC,i.warehouse_id,i.product_id
